label: Out of town (diet and training)
note: RECORDED IN ADVANCE, on the evening of August 13, at the owner's request -- which is a departure from this site's rule that it records and never schedules, and it was made deliberately and with that cost understood. Every other row here was written after the fact. The case for the exception: the gap was already certain, both the log and the training stopped together, and a week of unexplained empty days would otherwise read as abandoned tracking rather than a trip -- which is the exact confusion breaks.csv exists to prevent. THE END DATE IS NOW A RECORD AND IT MOVED TWICE: first written as August 19, extended to the 20th on the 19th when the owner gave the away period as August 14-20, and pulled back to the 19th on the morning of the 20th, when the owner reported being home, the break over, and a heavy-lower session planned. The 20th is a normal day and does not belong in a not-training stretch, so the one day this row ever held on intention alone has been removed rather than confirmed -- which is what the caveat it was born with asked for. August 14-19 is entirely a record. Training did not stop entirely: the away-from-the-gym routine ran on the 15th, 16th, 18th and 19th. Nothing was trained on the 14th or the 17th.
